claims.text: The hotel first opened its doors as Hotel De L'Europe on 23 September 1896.

findings.quote: On September 23rd of 1896 , the building first opened its doors as Hotel De L

claims.text: The hotel stands exactly where Het Rondeel, one of the main towers of Amsterdam's old city wall, once stood.

findings.quote: To defend the city, citizens built a wall with a for tress around it and named one of its main towers ‘Het Rondeel’. This stood exactly where De L’Europe Amsterdam stands today.

claims.text: Alfred 'Freddy' Heineken bought the hotel after frequenting it, and today it is owned by the HEINEKEN company.

findings.quote: As he frequented the hotel, he fell in love with the monumental building and the sophisticated atmosphere. He eventually decided to buy the hotel
Today the hotel is proudly owned by the HEINEKEN company.

claims.text: In 2020 the hotel had a complete redesign, with Dutch interior designers Nicemakers restyling the rooms, public areas, private event rooms, three restaurants and the bar.

findings.quote: In 2020 De L’Europe went through a complete redesign
Dutch-based interior designers ‘Nicemakers’ were responsible for the restyling of the rooms, public areas, private event rooms, three restaurants, and the bar.

claims.text: The hotel's restaurants include Restaurant Flore, Brasserie Marie and Trattoria Graziella.

findings.quote: Three of the city's finest restaurants under one roof: Michelin-starred Restaurant Flore, Brasserie Marie, and Trattoria Graziella.

claims.text: Freddy's Bar is named after Alfred 'Freddy' Heineken, who used to relax there.

findings.quote: A gentleman’s pub named after Alfred “Freddy” Heineken – who used to repose here.

claims.text: Freddy's Bar hosts live jazz and works on a walk-in basis, with no reservation needed.

findings.quote: enjoy live jazz. Freddy’s Bar operates on a walk-in basis, so feel free to drop by without making reservations.

claims.text: The spa has a heated indoor pool, saunas, relaxation areas and a fitness studio.

findings.quote: including the heated indoor pool, saunas, relaxation areas and fitness studio

claims.text: The spa offers Biologique Recherche facial treatments.

findings.quote: HIGH-PERFORMANCE FACIAL TREATMENTS

claims.text: The hotel sits at the crossroads of the Amstel River and the Rokin canal.

claims.text: The One-Bedroom Prestige Apartment has a fully equipped kitchen and is aimed at longer stays.

findings.quote: Perfect for longer visits, this apartment features a fully equipped kitchen

claims.text: The hotel is wheelchair friendly and has four elevators, including access to the spa.

findings.quote: De L'Europe Amsterdam is wheelchair friendly. The hotel has four elevators, including access to the spa

claims.text: The suites in the 't Huys wing are each designed by a local partner, and each comes with experiences linked to that partner.

findings.quote: They’re all designed by local partners, so every suite is a unique world of its own. Plus, each suite comes with experiences that really take you into the world of the local partner.

claims.text: Overnight guests get complimentary access to the spa and wellness facilities throughout their stay.

findings.quote: Overnight guests of De L’Europe enjoy complimentary access to the spa and wellness facilities throughout their stay.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served in a setting overlooking the Amstel River, and on the terrace on warmer days with good weather.

findings.quote: Relax in our charming setting overlooking the Amstel River
During warmer days and good weather, this refined high tea experience is served on our terrace

you can conveniently add your In-Huys Concept Store purchases to your room services bill
